name: catch-undo
title: Catch Undo
description: An Undo that catches. Delete a file and the row comes loose, drops out of the list and time slows as it falls into the dark. Hit Undo and a web shoots from the button: a twisted rope of silk fibres that frays open into a hand as it flies, wraps the row, stretches to slow it down gently and reels it back into its slot. Miss it and the row is simply gone. A slow-hand switch gives you more time, and an onCue callback exposes each stage for your own sound layer.
